dct_description_sm: Lebanon administrative level 0-3 edge-matched gazetteer and boundary files. SEE CAVEATS COD-EM datasets do not replace the authoritative [COD-AB available here](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-lbn); however COD-EM datasets may be preferred for cartographic purposes. See caveats. These layers are suitable for database or GIS linkage to the [Lebanon - Subnational Population Statistics](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ps-lbn) tables using the ADM0, ADM1, ADM2, and ADM3_PCODE fields. Vetting by Information Technology Outreach Services (ITOS) with funding from USAID.
